name: independent-proxy-sse-retry
reviewer: Independent reviewer (Claude Opus 5 CLI documentation review seat)

steps.action: The event stream stays open through the proxy and frames arrive unbuffered
steps.actual: GET /api/events through https://openlaw-review.localhost:43372 answered 200 with content-type text/event-stream; charset=utf-8 and x-accel-buffering no. Frames arrived on the open connection at 15008ms, 30008ms: [": heartbeat",": heartbeat"]. Both frames were the stream's own heartbeats, which is what shows the connection stays open and unbuffered; a buffering proxy would have withheld them. Contract 8 was created by the same signed-in user while the stream was open and did not itself produce a frame, so this step does not claim a record-change event.
